simple.meaning: מָעוֹן (mâʻôwn) is a Hebrew object word meaning “an abode , of God (the Tabernacle or the Temple), men (their home) or animals (their lair); hence, a retreat (asylum).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.short: an abode , of God (the Tabernacle or the Temple), men (their home) or animals (their lair); hence, a retreat (asylum)
definitions.full: H4583. maon or main I. מָעוֺן noun [masculine] dwelling, habitation ; — absolute ׳מ Psa 71:3 +, construct מְעוֺן Jer 25:30 +, suffix מְעוֺנֶ֑ךָ Psa 91:9 , etc.; — 1 lair of jackals Jer 9:10 ; 10:22 ; 49:33 ; 51:37 (all of desolated cities); ׳מ אֲרָיוֺת Nahum 2:12 (|| מִרְעֶה ; figurative of Nineveh). 2 dwelling of ׳י : a. in heaven ׳מ קָדְשְׁךָ Deut 26:15 compare Jer 25:30 (|| מָרוֺם ), Zechariah 2:17; Psa 68:6 ; 2Chr 30:27 . b. in temple ׳מ בְּיתֶ֑ךָ Psa 26:8 , מְעוֺנוֺ 2Chr 36:15 (only here alone). 3 figurative of ׳י as abode of his people, מ ׳צוּר Psa 71:3 , ׳מ alone 90:1 ; 91:9 . — ׳מ 1Sam 2:29 , 32 is unintelligible (see Commentaries), possibly read מְעוֺיֵן ( eyeing [enviously], see עין denominative) Klo HPS, compare ᵐ5 Bu. מְעוֺנָהּ Zeph 3:7 is difficult in context, ᵐ5 We Now read מֵעֵינֶיה (compare Josh 9:23 ; 2Sam 3:29 ).
definitions.rootNote: or מָעִין ; (1 Chronicles 4:41), from the same as 5772 ;

occurrences.englishText: Look down from your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless your people Israel, and the ground which you have given us, as you swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.”

Why do you kick at my sacrifice and at my offering, which I have commanded in my habitation, and honor your sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the best of all the offerings of Israel my people?’
You will see the affliction of my habitation, in all the wealth which I will give Israel. There shall not be an old man in your house forever.
Then the Levitical priests arose and blessed the people. Their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy habitation, even to heaven.
Yahweh, the God of their fathers, sent to them by his messengers, rising up early and sending, because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place;
Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house,
God sets the lonely in families.
Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go.
Lord,† The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
Because you have made Yahweh your refuge,
I will weep and wail for the mountains,
The voice of news, behold, it comes,
“Therefore prophesy against them all these words, and tell them,
Hazor will be a dwelling place of jackals,
The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his caves with the kill, and his dens with prey.
